section: Employment generation schemes - MGNREGA, PMEGP, DDU-GKY, PM-SVANidhi, Atmanirbhar packages

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the ministry and implementing agency associated with the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)?
o: Ministry of Skill Development; implemented by NSDC
Ministry of Labour and Employment; implemented by NCS
Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; implemented by KVIC
Ministry of Rural Development; implemented by DRDA
accepted.x: PMEGP is administered by the Ministry of MSME and implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC).
accepted.tq: Use the ‘who launched or implements it?’ method to distinguish neighbouring ministries and agencies.

accepted.s:
With reference to PMEGP, consider the following statements:
1. It supports new non-farm micro-enterprises in both rural and urban areas.
2. The margin-money subsidy generally ranges from 15 per cent to 35 per cent.
3. The maximum project cost is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for services.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe PMEGP: its target is new non-farm micro-enterprises, its margin money ranges from 15% to 35%, and its project caps are ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for services.
accepted.tq: Split the statements into target, subsidy and numerical-limit components before choosing the code.

accepted.s: PMEGP was formed by integrating which two earlier programmes?
accepted.x: PMEGP, launched in 2008, was formed by combining the Prime Minister’s Rozgar Yojana (PMRY) and the Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP).
accepted.tq: Identify the predecessor programmes rather than the ministry or beneficiary group.

accepted.s: The earlier project-cost limits under PMEGP, before the revised limits, were:
o: ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for services
₹20 lakh for manufacturing and ₹10 lakh for services
₹10 lakh for manufacturing and ₹5 lakh for services
₹25 lakh for manufacturing and ₹10 lakh for services
accepted.x: The earlier PMEGP limits were ₹25 lakh for manufacturing projects and ₹10 lakh for service projects; the later limits became ₹50 lakh and ₹20 lakh respectively.
accepted.tq: Compare the older and current numerical limits carefully instead of selecting the larger revised figures automatically.

accepted.s: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) is primarily associated with:
o: Collateral-free credit for urban street vendors
Formal employment incentives through EPF support
Placement-linked skill development for rural poor youth
accepted.x: DDU-GKY provides placement-linked skilling for rural poor youth and has its roots in the special projects of SGSY.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its distinctive target group and delivery mechanism.

accepted.s: Which ministry is associated with DDU-GKY?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
accepted.x: DDU-GKY is a programme of the Ministry of Rural Development.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between schemes serving rural youth, urban vendors and formal-sector employees.

accepted.s: PM-SVANidhi primarily provides:
o: Long-term housing loans to rural households
Subsidised loans to traditional artisans only
Collateral-free working-capital loans to street vendors
accepted.x: PM-SVANidhi provides collateral-free working-capital loans to street vendors. The scheme has covered more than 75 lakh vendors.
accepted.tq: Use the target occupation—street vendors—to separate PM-SVANidhi from other credit schemes.

accepted.s: PM Vishwakarma is implemented by which ministry and covers how many traditional artisan trades?
o: Ministry of Labour and Employment; 15 trades
accepted.x: PM Vishwakarma is associated with the Ministry of MSME and covers 18 traditional artisan trades, with training, toolkits and credit support.
accepted.tq: Combine the ministry clue with the exact count to avoid confusing artisan and skilling schemes.

accepted.s: Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan, launched in 2020, was designed as a 125-day campaign for returnee migrant workers in:
accepted.x: The campaign covered 116 districts in six States and was intended for returnee migrant workers.
accepted.tq: Read the duration, district count and State count as separate numerical clues.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: National Career Service — Labour and Employment — job-matching portal
Recognition of Prior Learning — Housing and Urban Affairs — street-vendor credit
PM-SVANidhi — Rural Development — rural youth skilling
accepted.x: The National Career Service belongs to the Labour and Employment domain and functions as a job-matching portal. The other pairs interchange the functions or ministries of different schemes.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure ministry-function pair and eliminate the swapped combinations.

accepted.s: The National Career Service had more than how many employers registered?
accepted.x: The National Career Service had more than 47.21 lakh employers registered.
accepted.tq: Distinguish lakh and crore scales before comparing the numerical options.

accepted.s: Recognition of Prior Learning under PMKVY is intended to:
o: Provide working capital to street vendors
Certify existing skills against the National Skills Qualifications Framework
Provide EPF support for new formal jobs
accepted.x: Recognition of Prior Learning certifies skills that individuals already possess against the National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF).
accepted.tq: Identify the scheme by the action it performs—assessment and certification of existing skills.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following initiatives in chronological order of their launch or introduction:
A. PMEGP
B. DDU-GKY
C. National Career Service
D. Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan
accepted.x: PMEGP dates to 2008, DDU-GKY to 2014, National Career Service to 2015, and Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan to 2020.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest initiatives first, then place the two middle-year programmes.

accepted.s: PMEGP met its target of creating how many new micro-enterprises, with what indicated distribution?
o: 4.02 lakh; 80 per cent rural and 40 per cent women
7.50 lakh; 40 per cent rural and 80 per cent women
4.02 crore; 80 per cent urban and 40 per cent women
2.50 lakh; 50 per cent rural and 35 per cent women
accepted.x: PMEGP met its target of 4.02 lakh new micro-enterprises; 80% were rural and 40% involved women.
accepted.tq: Keep the absolute figure separate from the two percentage distributions.

accepted.s: Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY), introduced under Aatmanirbhar Bharat 3.0, primarily provided:
o: Margin money for rural non-farm enterprises
EPF-linked incentives for new formal jobs
Certification of artisan skills under NSQF
accepted.x: ABRY incentivised the creation of new formal jobs by providing support linked to the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF).
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its distinctive instrument—EPF support for formal employment.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
o: Launched on 15 August 2025, with an outlay of ₹99,446 crore and a target of 3.5 crore jobs in two years
Launched in 2020, with an outlay of ₹50,000 crore and a target of 125 lakh migrant workers
Launched on 26 January 2026, with an outlay of ₹25,000 crore and a target of 4.02 lakh enterprises
Launched in 2015, with an outlay of ₹47,210 crore and a target of 75 lakh employers
accepted.x: PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana was launched on 15 August 2025, carries an outlay of ₹99,446 crore and targets 3.5 crore jobs over two years.
accepted.tq: Check the date, outlay and employment target together; famous-scheme traps often alter one figure.

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh ranked what position nationally under MGNREGS?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked fourth nationally under MGNREGS.
accepted.tq: Use the exact rank rather than assuming that a major-performing State occupied the first position.

accepted.s: Under the new Mission, Andhra Pradesh pooled rural development funds to provide how many days of employment in distressed rural pockets?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh pooled rural development funds to provide 125 days in distressed rural pockets under the new Mission.
accepted.tq: Separate the State-level extension from the standard figures commonly associated with employment guarantees.

accepted.s: During April–July 2026, the combined MGNREGA and VB-G RAM G programmes generated approximately how many person-days?
accepted.x: The two programmes generated only about 70 crore person-days during April–July 2026, which was 43% below the previous two-year average.
accepted.tq: Anchor the period first and then distinguish the actual person-days from the percentage shortfall.

accepted.s: The 70 crore person-days generated during April–July 2026 were approximately what percentage below the previous two-year average?
accepted.x: The figure was 43% below the previous two-year average, with the decline attributed to the transition limbo.
accepted.tq: Do not confuse the absolute output figure with the percentage comparison.

accepted.s: Which combination of demands was made by unions in relation to VB-G RAM G?
o: Extension to urban areas, 125 days and ₹500 wage
Abolition of wage employment and ₹700 pension
Replacement by PMEGP, 100 days and ₹350 wage
Rollback of the scheme, 200 days of employment and ₹700 wage
accepted.x: Unions sought rollback of VB-G RAM G, 200 days of employment and a wage of ₹700.
accepted.tq: Retain the three-part demand as a single issue-specific combination.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. A Supreme Court Bench discussed whether the right to work should be placed on a par with Article 21.
2. Olga Tellis (1985) linked livelihood with Article 21.
3. MGNREGA is described as the only law built on the right to work.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the Supreme Court discussion concerned the relationship between the right to work and Article 21, Olga Tellis linked livelihood to Article 21, and MGNREGA is described as the only law based on the right to work.
accepted.tq: Test the constitutional case, judicial discussion and broader significance as separate statements.

accepted.s: Which of the following best expresses the wider significance of MGNREGA?
o: It certifies prior learning under the NSQF.
It is primarily an urban credit programme for informal workers.
It serves as a safety net during agrarian distress and crises such as COVID-19.
accepted.x: MGNREGA is significant as a safety net during agrarian distress and emergencies such as the COVID-19 crisis, in addition to being associated with the right to work.
accepted.tq: Apply the scheme’s broader social-protection role to a crisis situation.
